description: Simulate defending your study or protocol before an ethics committee — the consent-comprehension probe, the vulnerable-participant challenge, the minimal-risk fight, the data-retention question you did not prepare for — with a debrief mapping every wobble to the protocol section that needs rewriting. Use when asked to prepare for an IRB or ethics review, rehearse an ethics-committee defence, why might ethics reject my study, or practice my protocol presentation. Rehearsal only — never a substitute for actual review.
